items.title: Tuts Washington Interview, 1968-09-02
items.q: Jimmy Cato was a, was a good piano player too.

ctx.x: Do you know a piano player named Ford? No. Or Poor Ray Nolan? Poor Ray, uh, I knew Poor Ray, he was an old man too when I was a kid. A bright fella, he died and he doesn't go too. But I never knew too much about him. Yeah, what do you mean by years ago? After the World War? Yeah, yeah, he's been dead or before. Oh, he died around in the world, around the World War II. Hmm. He was a World War II or something around that time. I was a kid, you know, playing around. He was, I heard he was good, but I never even hear…

I got it on tape and my Californian friend and I listened to this record, just listened to the music and the lyrics sounded so interesting. He was thinking about sitting in a jail or so. And he said they built up a new jail on Tulane and Broad. And we didn't know anything about them. These records were made in Jackson, Mississippi. But Tulane, Broad is just a common name for a spree, but Tulane sounded very much like New Orleans. And we got out the map and found this criminal. Tulane and Broad. Tulane and Broad.…
